verdict.rationale: Virtualization and container support is a fair axis for a laptop CPU, but the evidence pack never mentions VT-x/VT-d, hypervisors, or Docker workflows. It covers only AI, graphics, gaming, battery life and vPro manageability, none of which is about virtualization.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
